# Google OKF v0.1 conformance fixtures

These are original synthetic Yap fixtures written against Google Open Knowledge
Format v0.1 at upstream commit
`d44368c15e38e7c92481c5992e4f9b5b421a801d`.

- Specification: <https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/blob/d44368c15e38e7c92481c5992e4f9b5b421a801d/okf/SPEC.md>
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0
- Fixture content: synthetic; no upstream sample text, private transcript, or
  production knowledge was copied.
- Purpose: deterministic conformance, unknown-field preservation, relationship,
  permission, and retrieval tests.
